title: Cohere API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (length)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 characters vs the 40 the pinned gitleaks rule fixes, beside the same gate (basis: tool-undisputed). Twin of "Cohere API key (unprefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of cohere-api-key-llamaindex-rerank: length: 39 characters vs the 40 the pinned gitleaks rule fixes, beside the same gate (basis: tool-undisputed). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
